records.subject: Welcome aboard, Quartz Group
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone despite welcome email [email:19d5d192], a held kickoff [calendar:4edb6ed9], and an unanswered check-in [email:a232c4d9]. No customer reply at all and zero tickets suggests low engagement, though the attended kickoff and active Pro subscription keep some chance within the 8 remaining days.

draft.subject: Getting your first project set up
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the kickoff call last week. Following up on my note: if there's a workflow you're carrying over from your old tool, I'm glad to help you map it into Wrenfield.

A practical starting point is one project with a few tasks in it -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready to bring the team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help get that first project shaped up?

Best,
Chidi
